Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Completed through three subagents, following the project rules.

Use **Reproduce a game → Deal name** before exporting. Loading the snapshot restores its name; unnamed saves remain compatible.

Fixed pasted saves failing when JSON properties appear in a different order, while preserving strict validation.

Build/type checks, **153 unit/static tests**, and **86 browser tests** passed. Changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide check still flags 53 preexisting failures.

Details are in [README.md](/work/README.md).
